strategies.name: Breakout strategy
strategies.describe: Buys a coin when its price breaks above its 20-bar high with rising volume; exits on a trailing stop or after a set time.

trades.why_in: Price broke above its 20-bar high with rising volume
trades.why_out: Trailing stop hit (price fell 3× its usual swing from the high)

strategies.name: Bollinger breakout
strategies.describe: Buy when price closes above the upper Bollinger band (20 bars, 2.5 sd); sell when it closes below the middle band

trades.why_in: Its rule: buy when price closes above the upper Bollinger band (20 bars, 2.5 sd)

strategies.name: Volatility breakout
strategies.describe: Buy when a bar closes more than 2 × the 20-bar average range above the previous close (a volatility expansion); sell when price closes below its 20-bar EMA

trades.why_in: Its rule: buy when a bar closes more than 2 × the 20-bar average range above the previous close (a volatility expansion)

strategies.name: Blended portfolio
strategies.describe: Equal blend of 3 strategies (Risk-adjusted rotation + regime, Volatility breakout, Breakout) on one account; no coin above 10 % of equity; members' stop-losses are not applied inside the blend

strategies.name: Best other type
strategies.describe: Buy when price closes above the highest high of the last 100 bars; sell when it closes below the lowest low of the last 20 bars

trades.why_in: Its rule: buy when price closes above the highest high of the last 100 bars

strategies.name: Trend + BTC filter
strategies.describe: Only while BTC is above its 100-day average: buy when the 50-bar EMA is above the 200-bar EMA and price is above the slow EMA; sell when the fast EMA drops below the slow EMA or BTC falls below its average
